title: Sindh Development Authority Laws Repeal Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development Authority Laws Repeal Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY LAWS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY LAWS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXII of
2002
An Ordinance to
repeal the enactments relating to the Development Authorities in the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd July, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(22)/2002,
dated 3-7-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Development
Authorities Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 1st July, 2002.
